summary: Aerkomm Inc. filed this 8-K to report that its subsidiary, Aerkomm Taiwan, completed a merger with EJECTT INC. on March 11, 2026. Under the merger, each Ejectt share was converted into one Aerkomm Taiwan share. Post-merger, Aerkomm Taiwan is held 21.3% by Aerkomm Inc., 22.2% by dMobile System (with beneficial interest to Aerkomm Inc.), and 56.6% by former Ejectt shareholders. No cash consideration or premium was disclosed. The merger was approved by shareholders in May 2024 and by Taiwanese regulators. Watch for integration of Ejectt's solar and aluminum foil operations into Aerkomm's communications business.
